newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Jan 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Jan 29.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following major business stories on Jan. 29:
WASHINGTON - Joshua Fry is an expert in options trading, but his investment advice Web site doesn't explain that he's also a Jessup, Md. prisoner serving eight years for fraud.
WASHINGTON - Frank Zarb, a Wall Street executive who served in the Nixon and Ford adminstrations, was appointed to head the National Association of Securities Dealers.

WASHINGTON - The numbers that Netscape Communications Corp. reported from its California headquarters were impressive -- quarterly sales of $115 million, up 177 percent over a year ago, net income of $8.8 million, up 1,600 percent.
NEW YORK - Hilton Hotels Corp. chief Stephen Bollenbach is optimistic about his company's hostile bid for ITT Corp.
